title: VibeVoice, 7B

tricks: The big checkpoint can clone a voice; the 0.5B one cannot
The weights come from a community copy of the model Microsoft took down, and they are squeezed to 4-bit so they fit on a 16 GB card
No tags exist, so every sound is dropped

why: VibeVoice's large checkpoint, which can clone the upbeat female clip, to hear what the extra size buys.
